words.example: When is the assignment due?
The deadline is Friday.
The lecture starts at nine.
I need to revise for the exam.
The new semester begins in September.
Attendance is required.
She applied for a scholarship.
Please include your references.

grammar.title: 礼貌地向老师提问
grammar.explanation: 用 Could you 提出礼貌请求，后接动词原形。
grammar.example: Could you explain this word?
grammar.prompt: 选择向老师请教的正确表达

grammar.title: 表达学习计划
grammar.pattern: be going to + 动词原形
grammar.explanation: 表达已经做出的计划，be 随主语变化。
grammar.example: I am going to revise tonight.
grammar.prompt: 补充计划：She ___ going to study tonight.

grammar.title: 描述课程安排
grammar.pattern: 一般现在时 + 时间表达
grammar.explanation: 按时间表发生的事件通常用一般现在时；第三人称单数动词加 s。
grammar.example: The class starts at ten.
grammar.prompt: 选择正确的课程安排表达

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: Could you explain this question?
dialogue.translation: 您能解释一下这道题吗？

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.english: Of course. Which part is difficult?
dialogue.translation: 当然。哪一部分有困难？

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: I do not understand the last sentence.
dialogue.translation: 我不理解最后一句。

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.english: Let us look at it together.
dialogue.translation: 我们一起来看看。

words.example: We have a short quiz every Monday.
words.translation: 我们每周一有个小测验。

words.example: She got a good grade in history.
I have to finish my essay tonight.
Plagiarism can lead to a failing grade.
Can I ask for an extension on the deadline?
words.translation: 我能申请截止日期延期吗？

words.example: My tutor helps me with maths.
words.translation: 我的辅导老师帮我学数学。

words.example: Our group presentation is on Thursday.
Please send me your first draft.

grammar.title: 询问能否做某事
grammar.explanation: Can I 用来请求许可，后面接动词原形。
grammar.example: Can I hand in my essay tomorrow?
options: Can I to submit it later?

grammar.title: 已经完成的事
grammar.explanation: 现在完成时表示到现在为止已经完成的事。
grammar.example: I have finished my draft.

grammar.title: 必须做的事
grammar.explanation: have to 表示客观上必须做的事，主语是第三人称单数时用 has to。
grammar.example: He has to study for the quiz.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: Excuse me, can I ask for an extension on my essay?
dialogue.translation: 打扰一下，我的论文可以延期吗？

dialogue.speaker: Tutor
dialogue.english: Why do you need more time?
dialogue.translation: 你为什么需要更多时间？

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: I was sick last week, and I have only finished the first draft.
dialogue.translation: 我上周生病了，只写完了初稿。

dialogue.speaker: Tutor
dialogue.english: All right. Please send it to me by Friday.
dialogue.translation: 好的，请在周五前发给我。

words.example: I live in a dormitory on campus.
My roommate is from Canada.
The library closes at ten.
Let's have lunch in the canteen.
I joined the photography club.
Check your timetable for room changes.
words.translation: 查看课程表看看教室有没有变。

words.example: The campus is very big.
You need to register for the course online.
words.translation: 你需要在网上报名这门课。

grammar.title: 描述地点里有什么
grammar.explanation: 单数或不可数名词用 there is，复数用 there are。
grammar.example: There are two canteens on campus.
grammar.prompt: 补全：There ___ many clubs at our school.

grammar.title: 邀请别人一起做
grammar.explanation: Let's 用来提出一起做某事的建议。
grammar.example: Let's study in the library.
options: Let's to go to the club.

grammar.title: 表示频率
grammar.explanation: 频率副词放在实义动词前、be 动词后。
grammar.example: I usually eat in the canteen.
options: I go usually to the library.
Usually I go the library to.
I usually go to the library.
grammar.answer: I usually go to the library.

dialogue.speaker: Student A
dialogue.english: Hi, are you my new roommate?
dialogue.translation: 嗨，你是我的新室友吗？

dialogue.speaker: Student B
dialogue.english: Yes! I just moved into the dormitory today.
dialogue.translation: 是的！我今天刚搬进宿舍。

dialogue.speaker: Student A
dialogue.english: Have you registered for your courses yet?
dialogue.translation: 你选好课了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Student B
dialogue.english: Not yet. Let's check the timetable together.
dialogue.translation: 还没有。我们一起看看课程表吧。

words.example: Her thesis is about online learning.
words.translation: 她的论文是关于在线学习的。

words.example: Your argument needs more support.
words.translation: 你的论点需要更多支撑。

words.example: Use at least five reliable sources.
words.translation: 至少使用五个可靠的资料来源。

words.example: Always cite the author and the year.
words.translation: 一定要注明作者和年份。

words.example: Write a short summary of the article.
words.translation: 写一段文章的简短摘要。

words.example: Each paragraph should have one main idea.
words.translation: 每个段落应该只有一个中心思想。

words.example: The conclusion repeats the main points.
A good introduction gets attention.

grammar.title: 表达观点
grammar.pattern: I believe / I think + 句子
grammar.explanation: 用 I believe 引出自己的观点，比 I think 更正式。
grammar.example: I believe online classes are useful.
grammar.prompt: 选择最正式的表达观点
options: I am believe this is true.

grammar.title: 被动语态描述研究
grammar.pattern: It is + 过去分词 + that…
grammar.explanation: 学术写作常用被动语态让表达更客观。
grammar.example: It is known that sleep helps memory.
grammar.translation: 众所周知，睡眠有助于记忆。
options: It is known that exercise helps.
It is know that exercise helps.
grammar.answer: It is known that exercise helps.

grammar.title: 转折
grammar.explanation: However 表示转折，通常放在句首并加逗号。
grammar.example: The method is cheap. However, it is slow.
grammar.translation: 这种方法很便宜，但是很慢。
options: The data is useful, however it is old.
The data is useful. However, it is old.
The data is useful. However it, is old.
grammar.answer: The data is useful. However, it is old.

dialogue.speaker: Tutor
dialogue.english: Your argument is interesting, but your sources are weak.
dialogue.translation: 你的论点很有意思，但资料来源不够有力。

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: Should I add more recent studies?
dialogue.translation: 我应该加一些更新的研究吗？

dialogue.speaker: Tutor
dialogue.english: Yes, and remember to cite every source.
dialogue.translation: 对，记得每个来源都要注明出处。

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: Got it. I will also rewrite the conclusion.
dialogue.translation: 明白了，我也会重写结论。

words.example: I am applying for a summer internship.
The application form is online.
I have an interview on Tuesday.
She has a degree in economics.
What is your major?
I will graduate next June.
You will get a certificate after the course.
words.translation: 课程结束后你会拿到证书。

words.example: I volunteer at the library on weekends.
words.translation: 我周末在图书馆做志愿者。

grammar.title: 表达将来的安排
grammar.explanation: will 表示将来会发生的事或临时决定。
grammar.example: I will graduate next year.

grammar.title: 表达兴趣
grammar.pattern: be interested in + 名词 / 动名词
grammar.explanation: interested in 后接名词或 -ing 形式。
grammar.example: I am interested in working abroad.

grammar.title: 介绍经历
grammar.pattern: I have + 过去分词 + since / for…
grammar.explanation: 现在完成时说明从过去持续到现在的经历。
grammar.example: I have volunteered here for two years.
grammar.translation: 我在这里做志愿者两年了。
options: I have studied English for five years.
I study English since five years.
I have study English for five years.
grammar.answer: I have studied English for five years.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.english: Tell me about yourself.
dialogue.translation: 介绍一下你自己。

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: I am a final-year student. My major is marketing.
dialogue.translation: 我是大四学生，专业是市场营销。

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.english: Why are you interested in this internship?
dialogue.translation: 你为什么对这份实习感兴趣？

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: I want to use what I have learned in a real company.
dialogue.translation: 我想在真正的公司里运用所学。

name: 律师
subtitle: 客户沟通、合同与法律表达

words.example: Please review the contract.
This clause describes the payment terms.
The agreement limits our liability.
We need more evidence.
The client filed a claim.
They reached a settlement.
This information is confidential.
We need your written consent.
words.translation: 我们需要您的书面同意。

grammar.title: 表达合同义务
grammar.explanation: must 用于表达义务；这里用于英语学习，具体法律效力取决于司法管辖区与合同。
grammar.example: The tenant must pay the rent on time.
grammar.translation: 租户必须按时支付租金。
grammar.prompt: 选择表达义务的正确句子

grammar.title: 描述文件处理
grammar.pattern: be + 过去分词（被动语态）
grammar.explanation: 被动语态强调文件受到的处理，be 与主语和时态一致。
grammar.example: The agreement was signed yesterday.

grammar.title: 说明条件与后果
grammar.pattern: If + 一般现在时, will + 动词原形
grammar.explanation: 第一条件句用于说明可能发生的条件及后果。
grammar.example: If you agree, we will prepare the documents.
grammar.translation: 如果您同意，我们将准备文件。
options: If you agree, we will prepare the documents.
If you will agree, we prepares the documents.
If you agrees, we prepare yesterday.
grammar.answer: If you agree, we will prepare the documents.

dialogue.speaker: Client
dialogue.english: I have a question about this contract.
dialogue.translation: 我对这份合同有一个疑问。

dialogue.speaker: Lawyer
dialogue.english: Could you describe what happened?
dialogue.translation: 您能描述一下发生了什么吗？

dialogue.speaker: Lawyer
dialogue.english: Let us review the payment clause first.
dialogue.translation: 我们先审阅付款条款。

dialogue.speaker: Client
dialogue.english: Thank you. Is this information confidential?
dialogue.translation: 谢谢。这些信息会保密吗？

words.example: The client arrived at ten.
Our fee is based on the hours we work.
words.translation: 我们的费用按工作小时计算。

words.example: This case may take six months.
words.translation: 这个案件可能需要六个月。

words.example: The witness saw the accident.
Please read your statement carefully.
Bring every document you have.
words.translation: 把你所有的文件都带来。

words.example: We need your signature on page three.
words.translation: 我们需要你在第三页签名。

words.example: You have the right to know your rights.
words.translation: 你有权了解自己的权利。

grammar.title: 礼貌请求对方提供
grammar.pattern: Could you please + 动词原形…?
grammar.explanation: please 让请求更礼貌，后接动词原形。
grammar.example: Could you please bring the documents?
options: Could you please to sign here?

grammar.title: 询问过去发生的事
grammar.pattern: When / Where did + 主语 + 动词原形?
grammar.explanation: 一般过去时的疑问句用 did，后面动词用原形。
grammar.example: When did the accident happen?
grammar.translation: 事故是什么时候发生的？

grammar.title: 说明费用
grammar.explanation: cost 表示花费，主语通常是事物。
grammar.example: The first meeting costs 100 dollars.
grammar.translation: 第一次咨询收费 100 美元。

dialogue.speaker: Client
dialogue.english: How much is your fee for this case?
dialogue.translation: 这个案件你们收费多少？

dialogue.speaker: Lawyer
dialogue.english: The first meeting costs 100 dollars.
dialogue.translation: 第一次面谈收费 100 美元。

dialogue.speaker: Client
dialogue.english: Do I need to bring any documents?
dialogue.translation: 我需要带什么文件吗？

dialogue.speaker: Lawyer
dialogue.english: Yes, please bring the contract and any statement from the witness.
dialogue.translation: 需要，请带上合同和证人的陈述。

words.example: Please read the terms before you sign.
A late payment is a breach of contract.
Each party must sign the agreement.
words.translation: 每一方都必须签署协议。

words.example: The seller has an obligation to deliver on time.
words.translation: 卖方有按时交货的义务。

words.example: The termination clause is on page five.
We want to renew the contract for one year.
words.translation: 我们想把合同续签一年。

words.example: The deposit will be returned after the inspection.
There is a penalty for late delivery.

grammar.title: 义务与禁止
grammar.pattern: shall / shall not + 动词原形
grammar.explanation: 合同中 shall 表示“应当”，shall not 表示“不得”。
grammar.example: The buyer shall pay within 30 days.
grammar.translation: 买方应在 30 日内付款。
options: The tenant shall not sublet the flat.
The tenant shall not sublets the flat.
The tenant not shall sublet the flat.
grammar.answer: The tenant shall not sublet the flat.

grammar.title: 条件条款
grammar.pattern: In the event that + 句子
grammar.explanation: In the event that 是正式的“如果发生……”。
grammar.example: In the event that the goods are damaged, the seller shall replace them.
grammar.translation: 若货物损坏，卖方应予更换。
options: In the event of the payment is late, …
In the event that payment is late, …
In event that payment is late, …
grammar.answer: In the event that payment is late, …

grammar.title: 截止时间
grammar.explanation: no later than 表示“不迟于”，比 before 更严格。
grammar.example: Notice must be given no later than June 1.
grammar.translation: 通知须不迟于 6 月 1 日发出。
grammar.prompt: 补全：Payment is due no ___ than Friday.

dialogue.speaker: Client
dialogue.english: The other party says I am in breach of contract.
dialogue.translation: 对方说我违约了。

dialogue.speaker: Lawyer
dialogue.english: Which obligation do they say you failed to meet?
dialogue.translation: 他们说你没有履行哪项义务？

dialogue.speaker: Client
dialogue.english: They say I paid the deposit late.
dialogue.translation: 他们说我付定金晚了。

dialogue.speaker: Lawyer
dialogue.english: Let me check the terms. The penalty may not apply.
dialogue.translation: 我看一下条款，罚金可能不适用。

words.example: The case will go to court next month.
The judge asked the witness a question.
words.translation: 法官问了证人一个问题。

words.example: The hearing starts at nine.
The trial lasted three days.
The jury reached a verdict.
We plan to appeal the decision.
words.translation: 我们打算对判决提起上诉。

words.example: She decided to sue the company.
The defendant did not attend the hearing.

grammar.title: 被动语态描述程序
grammar.explanation: 将来时的被动语态表示某事将被处理。
grammar.example: The case will be heard next week.
options: The verdict will be announced tomorrow.
The verdict will be announce tomorrow.
grammar.answer: The verdict will be announced tomorrow.

grammar.title: 建议
grammar.pattern: I recommend that + 主语 + 动词原形
grammar.explanation: 正式建议中 that 从句用动词原形。
grammar.example: I recommend that you settle the case.
options: I recommend that she appeals to.

grammar.title: 解释可能性
grammar.explanation: may 和 might 表示可能，might 更不确定。
grammar.example: The judge might delay the hearing.
grammar.prompt: 补全：We ___ win the appeal, but it is not certain.

dialogue.speaker: Client
dialogue.english: Will the case go to court?
dialogue.translation: 这个案子会上法庭吗？

dialogue.speaker: Lawyer
dialogue.english: Yes. The hearing will be held on May 3.
dialogue.translation: 会的，庭审定在 5 月 3 日。

dialogue.speaker: Client
dialogue.english: What if we lose the trial?
dialogue.translation: 如果我们败诉怎么办？

dialogue.speaker: Lawyer
dialogue.english: Then we might appeal the verdict.
dialogue.translation: 那我们可能会对判决提起上诉。

words.example: The tenant reported a broken heater.
The landlord must repair the roof.
The lease ends in December.
Your employer must pay you on time.
words.translation: 你的雇主必须按时付工资。

words.example: Every employee has a written contract.
words.translation: 每位员工都有书面合同。

words.example: She believes her dismissal was unfair.
words.translation: 她认为自己被解雇不公平。

words.example: He received compensation for the injury.
You must give one month's notice.
words.translation: 你必须提前一个月通知。

grammar.title: 权利
grammar.pattern: have the right to + 动词原形
grammar.explanation: 表示依法享有做某事的权利。
grammar.example: You have the right to see your file.
options: Tenants have the right to a safe home.
Tenants have right of a safe home.
Tenants has the right to a safe home.
grammar.answer: Tenants have the right to a safe home.

grammar.title: 过去进行时说明背景
grammar.explanation: 描述过去某个时刻正在发生的事。
grammar.example: I was working when he called me.
grammar.translation: 他打电话时我正在工作。
grammar.prompt: 补全：They ___ waiting for the landlord.

grammar.title: 说明要求
grammar.pattern: be required to + 动词原形
grammar.explanation: 正式表达“被要求做”。
grammar.example: Employers are required to give notice.
options: The tenant is required pay rent.
The tenant is required to pay rent.
The tenant required to pay rent.
grammar.answer: The tenant is required to pay rent.

dialogue.speaker: Client
dialogue.english: My landlord wants to keep my deposit.
dialogue.translation: 我的房东想扣下我的押金。

dialogue.speaker: Lawyer
dialogue.english: Did you give notice before you moved out?
dialogue.translation: 你搬走前提前通知了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Client
dialogue.english: Yes, one month's notice, as the lease says.
dialogue.translation: 通知了，按租约提前一个月。

dialogue.speaker: Lawyer
dialogue.english: Then you have the right to get it back.
dialogue.translation: 那你有权拿回押金。

words.example: Do you have a reservation?
Here is the menu.
Do you have a food allergy?
Let me check the ingredients.
I recommend the vegetable soup.
Would you like the bill?
Is this for takeaway?
A table is available now.

grammar.title: 礼貌接单
grammar.pattern: Would you like + 名词 / to do…?
grammar.explanation: 询问客人意愿时使用 Would you like；动词前加 to。
grammar.example: Would you like some water?
grammar.prompt: 选择礼貌询问客人意愿的句子

grammar.title: 确认食物过敏
grammar.pattern: Do you have any + 复数名词…?
grammar.explanation: 一般疑问句中常用 any，allergy 的复数为 allergies。过敏信息应实际核对，不能猜测。
grammar.example: Do you have any food allergies?

grammar.title: 致歉并说明等待
grammar.pattern: I am sorry, but… / will + 动词原形
grammar.explanation: 先致歉，再用 will 说明接下来将发生的事情。
grammar.example: I am sorry, but your order will take ten minutes.
grammar.translation: 很抱歉，您的餐点还需要十分钟。
options: Your order will takes ten minutes.
Your order will take ten minutes.
Your order will taking ten minutes.
grammar.answer: Your order will take ten minutes.

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.english: Welcome! Do you have a reservation?
dialogue.translation: 欢迎光临！您有预订吗？

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.english: Yes, a table for two under Chen.
dialogue.translation: 有，两位，姓陈。

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.english: This way, please. Do you have any food allergies?
dialogue.translation: 这边请。您有任何食物过敏吗？

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.english: Yes, I am allergic to peanuts.
dialogue.translation: 有，我对花生过敏。

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.english: Thank you for telling me. I will check with the kitchen.
dialogue.translation: 谢谢告知。我会和厨房核对。

words.example: Are you ready to order?
I'll have the soup as a starter.
The main course comes with rice.
Would you like to see the dessert menu?
You can choose one side dish.
The portion is big enough for two.
Is this dish spicy?
We have three vegetarian options.

grammar.title: 点餐
grammar.explanation: I'll have 是点餐最常用的表达。
grammar.example: I'll have the chicken, please.

grammar.title: 询问是否需要
grammar.explanation: 礼貌地询问客人想要什么。
grammar.example: Would you like a dessert?

grammar.title: 推荐
grammar.pattern: I'd recommend + 名词 / 动词-ing
grammar.explanation: recommend 后接名词或动名词，不接 to do。
grammar.example: I'd recommend the beef.

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.english: Good evening. Are you ready to order?
dialogue.translation: 晚上好，可以点菜了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.english: Yes. Is the curry spicy?
dialogue.translation: 可以。咖喱辣吗？

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.english: A little. If you prefer mild food, I'd recommend the pasta.
dialogue.translation: 有一点。如果您喜欢清淡的，我推荐意面。

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.english: OK, I'll have the pasta and a side dish of salad.
dialogue.translation: 好的，我要意面和一份沙拉配菜。

words.example: The chef prepares the sauce every morning.
words.translation: 厨师每天早上准备酱汁。

words.example: Keep the kitchen clean.
Please prepare the vegetables.
We only use fresh fish.
Put the frozen peas in the freezer.
Boil the water before adding the noodles.
Fry the onions until they are soft.
Slice the bread thinly.

grammar.title: 下指令
grammar.pattern: 动词原形开头的祈使句
grammar.explanation: 厨房里下指令直接用动词原形开头。
grammar.example: Wash your hands first.

grammar.title: 先后顺序
grammar.explanation: 用顺序词说明操作步骤。
grammar.example: First, boil the water. Then, add salt.
options: First, boil the rice. Then, add salt.
First boil, then the rice salt.
grammar.answer: First, boil the rice. Then, add salt.

grammar.title: 说明正在做
grammar.explanation: 现在进行时说明此刻正在做的事。
grammar.example: The chef is frying the fish.
grammar.prompt: 补全：We ___ preparing the sauce now.

dialogue.speaker: Chef
dialogue.english: Have you prepared the vegetables?
dialogue.translation: 蔬菜准备好了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Cook
dialogue.english: Yes. I am slicing the carrots now.
dialogue.translation: 好了，我正在切胡萝卜。

dialogue.speaker: Chef
dialogue.english: Good. Then fry the onions, but don't burn them.
dialogue.translation: 很好，然后炒洋葱，别炒糊了。

dialogue.speaker: Cook
dialogue.english: Should I use fresh or frozen peas?
dialogue.translation: 我用新鲜的还是冷冻的豌豆？

words.example: Could I have a receipt, please?
The tip is not included.
We will give you a full refund.
I would like to make a complaint.
Here is your change.
Students get a ten percent discount.
Can we split the bill?
Do you accept cash?

grammar.title: 道歉并说明处理
grammar.pattern: I'm sorry for + 名词 / 动词-ing
grammar.explanation: sorry for 后接名词或动名词。
grammar.example: I'm sorry for the long wait.
options: I'm sorry for keep you waiting.
I'm sorry for keeping you waiting.
I'm sorry to keeping you waiting.
grammar.answer: I'm sorry for keeping you waiting.

grammar.title: 提出解决办法
grammar.explanation: Let me 表示主动去做某事。
grammar.example: Let me get you a new one.

grammar.title: 委婉表达不满
grammar.explanation: I'm afraid 让坏消息或不满听起来更委婉。
grammar.example: I'm afraid this soup is cold.
options: I'm afraid the steak is overcooked.
I afraid the steak is overcooked.
I'm afraid of the steak overcooked.
grammar.answer: I'm afraid the steak is overcooked.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.english: Excuse me, I'm afraid my steak is cold.
dialogue.translation: 打扰一下，我的牛排恐怕是凉的。

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.english: I'm sorry about that. Let me get you a new one.
dialogue.translation: 很抱歉，我给您换一份。

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.english: Thank you. Can we split the bill later?
dialogue.translation: 谢谢。待会儿我们可以分开结账吗？

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.english: Of course. We'll also give you a discount today.
dialogue.translation: 当然，今天我们还会给您打折。

words.example: Good hygiene keeps customers safe.
words.translation: 良好的卫生能保障顾客安全。

words.example: Wear gloves when you handle raw meat.
Check the expiry date on the milk.
Raw meat needs cold storage.
Label every container with the date.
words.translation: 每个容器都要贴上日期标签。

words.example: Rinse the rice before cooking.
Clean up the spill right away.
words.translation: 马上清理洒出来的东西。

words.example: The health inspection is next week.

grammar.title: 规定
grammar.pattern: must / must not + 动词原形
grammar.explanation: must 表示必须，must not 表示禁止。
grammar.example: Staff must not smoke in the kitchen.

grammar.title: 说明时间条件
grammar.explanation: before 和 after 后可以直接接动名词。
grammar.example: Wash your hands after touching raw meat.
grammar.prompt: 补全：Check the label before ___ the food.

grammar.title: 被动语态说明规范
grammar.explanation: 说明物品应该被如何处理。
grammar.example: Fish should be stored below 4°C.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.english: The health inspection is tomorrow. Is everything labelled?
dialogue.translation: 明天卫生检查，东西都贴标签了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Cook
dialogue.english: Yes, and I checked the expiry date on everything.
dialogue.translation: 都贴了，我也检查了所有东西的保质期。

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.english: Good. Remember to wear gloves with raw meat.
dialogue.translation: 很好，处理生肉记得戴手套。

dialogue.speaker: Cook
dialogue.english: Sure. I'll also clean the spill near the fridge.
dialogue.translation: 好的，我也会把冰箱旁边洒的东西清理掉。

name: 医护人员
subtitle: 接待、症状询问与日常照护

words.example: What symptoms do you have?
Do you have an appointment?
Please bring your prescription.
I will take your temperature.
Do you feel dizzy?
Are you allergic to any medicines?
Could you tell me about your medical history?
words.translation: 您能告诉我您的病史吗？

words.example: Please book a follow-up appointment.

grammar.title: 询问持续时间
grammar.pattern: How long have you + 过去分词…?
grammar.explanation: 现在完成时询问从过去持续到现在的情况。这里只练习语言，不进行诊断。
grammar.example: How long have you felt this way?
grammar.prompt: 选择正确的持续时间问法
options: How long have you felt this way?
How long has you feel this way?
How long have you feel this way?
grammar.answer: How long have you felt this way?

grammar.title: 给出简单操作指引
grammar.explanation: 用 please 使指引更礼貌；此处仅为语言示例，实际操作遵循临床规范。
grammar.example: Please sit down and relax.

grammar.title: 询问正在发生的感受
grammar.explanation: 现在进行时可询问当下的身体感受。
grammar.example: Are you feeling better now?
grammar.prompt: 选择询问当前感受的正确表达

dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.english: Hello. Do you have an appointment?
dialogue.translation: 您好。您有预约吗？

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Yes. I have been feeling dizzy.
dialogue.translation: 有。我一直感到头晕。

dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.english: How long have you felt this way?
dialogue.translation: 您这样感觉有多久了？

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Since this morning.
dialogue.translation: 从今天早上开始。

words.example: Where is the pain?
I have had a cough for a week.
She has a high fever.
I often get a headache in the afternoon.
Warm water helps a sore throat.
The medicine may cause nausea.
words.translation: 这种药可能会引起恶心。

words.example: The rash appeared yesterday.
My ankle is swollen.

grammar.title: 描述症状
grammar.explanation: 描述疾病和症状常用 have。
grammar.example: I have a headache.

grammar.title: 询问部位
grammar.explanation: hurt 表示“疼”，主语是 it 时用 does。
grammar.example: Does it hurt when you walk?

grammar.title: 描述程度
grammar.explanation: 请病人用 1 到 10 描述疼痛程度。
grammar.example: On a scale of 1 to 10, how bad is the pain?
grammar.translation: 用 1 到 10 分，疼痛有多严重？
grammar.prompt: 补全：On a scale ___ 1 to 10, it is a 6.

dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.english: What seems to be the problem today?
dialogue.translation: 今天哪里不舒服？

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: I have a sore throat and a fever.
dialogue.translation: 我嗓子疼，还发烧。

dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.english: When did the fever start?
dialogue.translation: 什么时候开始发烧的？

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Two days ago. I also have a bad cough.
dialogue.translation: 两天前。我还咳得很厉害。

words.example: We need to do a blood test.
The X-ray shows a small crack.
words.translation: X 光显示有个小裂缝。

words.example: You will need an injection.
Take one dose every eight hours.
A common side effect is feeling sleepy.
The treatment takes two weeks.
The doctor will explain the diagnosis.
He needs surgery on his knee.

grammar.title: 解释检查目的
grammar.explanation: 用不定式说明做某事的目的。
grammar.example: We need an X-ray to check the bone.
grammar.translation: 我们需要拍 X 光检查骨头。
options: We'll take blood for checking your sugar.
We'll take blood to check your sugar.
We'll take blood check your sugar.
grammar.answer: We'll take blood to check your sugar.

grammar.title: 安抚病人
grammar.explanation: 提前告诉病人可能的感受。
grammar.example: You may feel a little pain.
grammar.prompt: 补全：You may ___ a little dizzy after the injection.

grammar.title: 给出建议
grammar.pattern: It's best to + 动词原形
grammar.explanation: 温和地提出建议。
grammar.example: It's best to rest for a few days.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.english: The X-ray is normal, but we need a blood test.
dialogue.translation: X 光正常，但我们需要验血。

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Will the treatment have any side effects?
dialogue.translation: 治疗会有副作用吗？

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.english: You may feel a little tired. It's best to rest.
dialogue.translation: 你可能会有点累，最好多休息。

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: How long will the treatment take?
dialogue.translation: 治疗需要多长时间？

words.example: The patient is in Ward 5.
Press the button to call the nurse.
The patient is resting now.
You can go home after discharge tomorrow.
words.translation: 你明天办理出院后就可以回家。

words.example: I will change your bandage.
Please sit in the wheelchair.
I need to check your vital signs.
words.translation: 我需要检查你的生命体征。

words.example: Take your medication after meals.

grammar.title: 告知要做的事
grammar.pattern: I'm going to + 动词原形
grammar.explanation: 护理前告诉病人接下来要做什么。
grammar.example: I'm going to check your blood pressure.
options: I'm going to change your bandage.
I going to change your bandage.
grammar.answer: I'm going to change your bandage.

grammar.title: 询问需要
grammar.pattern: Do you need + 名词 / to do…?
grammar.explanation: 询问病人是否需要帮助。
grammar.example: Do you need help getting up?
grammar.prompt: 补全：Do you need ___ more water?

grammar.title: 提醒
grammar.explanation: Remember to 提醒对方别忘了做某事。
grammar.example: Remember to take your medication.
options: Remember to take your medicine tonight.
grammar.answer: Remember to take your medicine tonight.

dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.english: Good morning. I'm going to check your vital signs.
dialogue.translation: 早上好，我要检查一下你的生命体征。

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: When can I go home?
dialogue.translation: 我什么时候能回家？

dialogue.speaker: Nurse
dialogue.english: The doctor says your discharge is tomorrow.
dialogue.translation: 医生说你明天可以出院。

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Great. Do I need to take any medication at home?
dialogue.translation: 太好了。我在家需要吃药吗？

words.example: The pharmacy is open until nine.
Ask the pharmacist if you have questions.
Take two tablets with water.
Swallow the capsule whole.
Put the ointment on the rash twice a day.
words.translation: 一天两次在皮疹处涂药膏。

words.example: Can I get a refill of this prescription?
Read the instructions on the box.
This medicine will expire next month.

grammar.title: 用药频率
grammar.explanation: 用 once / twice / three times a day 说明频率。
grammar.example: Take it three times a day.
grammar.prompt: 补全：Use the ointment ___ a day.

grammar.title: 用药时间
grammar.explanation: 说明服药与吃饭的关系。
grammar.example: Take the tablet with food.

grammar.title: 提醒不要做
grammar.explanation: 否定祈使句用于提醒禁止事项。
grammar.example: Don't drink alcohol with this medicine.
options: Don't to drive after taking it.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Hi, I'd like to get a refill of my prescription.
dialogue.translation: 你好，我想续配我的处方药。

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.english: Sure. Take one tablet twice a day after meals.
dialogue.translation: 好的，每天两次，饭后各服一片。

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Can I take it with other medicine?
dialogue.translation: 能和其他药一起吃吗？

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.english: Please read the instructions, and don't drink alcohol with it.
dialogue.translation: 请阅读说明，服药期间不要喝酒。

words.example: Let us look at the agenda.
I will send you the proposal.
The project is within budget.
Could we change the schedule?
Thank you for your feedback.
She is my colleague.
Please confirm the meeting time.
Please see the attachment.

grammar.title: 礼貌提出会议建议
grammar.explanation: 使用 Could we 提出共同参与的建议或请求。
grammar.example: Could we meet on Thursday?

grammar.title: 汇报已经完成的工作
grammar.explanation: 现在完成时强调过去的动作与当前结果的联系。
grammar.example: We have finished the report.

grammar.title: 邮件中的礼貌请求
grammar.explanation: mind 后接动名词，即动词的 -ing 形式。
grammar.example: Would you mind sending the file?
grammar.translation: 您介意把文件发过来吗？
options: Would you mind sending the file?
Would you mind send the file?
Would you mind to send the file?
grammar.answer: Would you mind sending the file?

dialogue.speaker: Colleague
dialogue.english: Could we discuss the proposal today?
dialogue.translation: 我们今天能讨论一下方案吗？

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Of course. What time works for you?
dialogue.translation: 当然。您什么时间方便？

dialogue.speaker: Colleague
dialogue.english: How about three in the afternoon?
dialogue.translation: 下午三点怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: That works for me. I will send an invitation.
dialogue.translation: 我可以。我会发一个邀请。

words.example: Thanks for your quick reply.
I will forward the email to my manager.
words.translation: 我会把邮件转发给经理。

words.example: The deadline for the report is Monday.
words.translation: 报告的截止日期是周一。

words.example: Here is a quick update on the project.
I have a request about the meeting room.
words.translation: 关于会议室我有个请求。

words.example: This is a friendly reminder about Friday.
words.translation: 友情提醒一下周五的事。

words.example: Best regards, Anna
My inbox is full of emails.

grammar.title: 邮件开头说明目的
grammar.pattern: I'm writing to + 动词原形
grammar.explanation: 正式邮件第一句常说明写信目的。
grammar.example: I'm writing to confirm our meeting.
grammar.translation: 写信是为了确认我们的会议。
options: I'm writing for ask about the price.
I'm writing to ask about the price.
I write to asking about the price.
grammar.answer: I'm writing to ask about the price.

grammar.title: 附件说明
grammar.explanation: 邮件中说明附件的固定表达。
grammar.example: Please find attached the report.

grammar.title: 期待回复
grammar.pattern: I look forward to + 动词-ing
grammar.explanation: look forward to 的 to 是介词，后接动名词。
grammar.example: I look forward to hearing from you.
options: I look forward to hear from you.
I look forward to hearing from you.
I look forward hearing from you.
grammar.answer: I look forward to hearing from you.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.english: Did you reply to the client's email?
dialogue.translation: 你回复客户的邮件了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Assistant
dialogue.english: Yes, and I forwarded it to the sales team.
dialogue.translation: 回了，我也转发给了销售团队。

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.english: Good. Please send them a reminder about the deadline.
dialogue.translation: 很好，请提醒他们截止日期。

dialogue.speaker: Assistant
dialogue.english: Sure. I'll send an update this afternoon.
dialogue.translation: 好的，我下午发一个进度更新。

words.example: Who will take the minutes?
Her presentation was very clear.
Ten people will attend the meeting.
We need to postpone the meeting.
Let's discuss the budget first.
We made a decision yesterday.
Can you give us a summary?
words.translation: 你能给我们总结一下吗？

words.example: Please go back to the last slide.

grammar.title: 开场
grammar.explanation: 主持会议时引出第一个议题。
grammar.example: Let's start with the sales report.
grammar.translation: 我们先从销售报告开始。

grammar.title: 礼貌地插话
grammar.explanation: 打断别人时先礼貌致歉。
grammar.example: Sorry to interrupt, but I have a question.
grammar.prompt: 补全：Sorry to ___, but can I add something?

grammar.title: 表达同意与保留
grammar.explanation: 先表示同意，再提出不同看法。
grammar.example: I agree, but the cost is high.
options: I agree with you, but it's risky.
grammar.answer: I agree with you, but it's risky.

dialogue.speaker: Chair
dialogue.english: Let's start with the sales update. Tom?
dialogue.translation: 我们先从销售情况开始。汤姆？

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.english: Sales rose by ten percent. Here is the next slide.
dialogue.translation: 销售增长了百分之十，请看下一张幻灯片。

dialogue.speaker: Lisa
dialogue.english: Sorry to interrupt, but should we postpone the launch?
dialogue.translation: 抱歉打断，我们是不是该推迟发布？

dialogue.speaker: Chair
dialogue.english: Let's discuss that after the presentation.
dialogue.translation: 汇报结束后我们再讨论这个。

words.example: The customer wants a faster delivery.
We will send you a quotation today.
words.translation: 我们今天把报价单发给您。

words.example: The invoice is due in 30 days.
We need to negotiate the price.
We can deliver the goods next week.
We reached our sales target.
Revenue grew last quarter.
We closed the deal on Friday.
words.translation: 我们周五谈成了这笔生意。

grammar.title: 提出条件
grammar.explanation: 用条件句提出交换条件。
grammar.example: If you order 500 units, we can offer a discount.
grammar.translation: 如果您订 500 件，我们可以打折。
options: If you will pay now, we can deliver today.
If you pay now, we can deliver today.
If you paid now, we can deliver today.
grammar.answer: If you pay now, we can deliver today.

grammar.title: 比较
grammar.explanation: 比较两个选项时用比较级加 than。
grammar.example: Our price is lower than theirs.
grammar.prompt: 补全：This model is ___ than the old one.

grammar.title: 委婉拒绝
grammar.pattern: I'm afraid we can't + 动词原形
grammar.explanation: 委婉表示做不到。
grammar.example: I'm afraid we can't lower the price.
grammar.translation: 恐怕我们不能再降价了。
options: I'm afraid we can't deliver by Monday.
I afraid we can't deliver by Monday.
I'm afraid we not can deliver by Monday.
grammar.answer: I'm afraid we can't deliver by Monday.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Your quotation is higher than we expected.
dialogue.translation: 你们的报价比我们预期的高。

dialogue.speaker: Sales
dialogue.english: If you order more units, we can offer a better price.
dialogue.translation: 如果您多订一些，我们可以给更好的价格。

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Can you deliver by the end of the month?
dialogue.translation: 你们能在月底前交货吗？

dialogue.speaker: Sales
dialogue.english: Yes. I'll send you the new quotation today.
dialogue.translation: 可以，我今天把新的报价单发给您。

words.example: I have five years of experience in sales.
Communication is an important skill.
words.translation: 沟通是一项重要的技能。

words.example: My biggest strength is teamwork.
words.translation: 我最大的优点是团队合作。

words.example: What salary do you expect?
She decided to resign last month.
He got a promotion this year.
I enjoy working in a team.
I was responsible for three clients.

grammar.title: 介绍职责
grammar.pattern: be responsible for + 名词 / 动词-ing
grammar.explanation: responsible for 后接名词或动名词。
grammar.example: I was responsible for training new staff.
grammar.prompt: 补全：I am responsible ___ the budget.

grammar.title: 说明成就
grammar.pattern: I managed to + 动词原形
grammar.explanation: managed to 表示经过努力成功做到。
grammar.example: I managed to cut costs by 20%.

grammar.title: 提问
grammar.pattern: I'd like to know + 宾语从句
grammar.explanation: 宾语从句用陈述语序。
grammar.example: I'd like to know when I can start.
grammar.translation: 我想知道什么时候可以入职。
options: I'd like to know what is the salary.
I'd like to know what the salary is.
I'd like know what the salary is.
grammar.answer: I'd like to know what the salary is.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.english: Tell me about your experience.
dialogue.translation: 说说你的工作经验。

dialogue.speaker: Candidate
dialogue.english: I worked in sales for three years. I was responsible for ten clients.
dialogue.translation: 我做了三年销售，负责十个客户。

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.english: What is your biggest strength?
dialogue.translation: 你最大的优点是什么？

dialogue.speaker: Candidate
dialogue.english: I work well in a team, and I managed to reach every target.
dialogue.translation: 我擅长团队合作，每个指标都完成了。

words.example: Let me introduce my friend Sam.
words.translation: 我来介绍一下我的朋友萨姆。

words.example: Nice to meet you.
My neighbor has a big dog.
My hobby is cooking.
What do you do on the weekend?
She is my best friend.
I live near the park.
What is your job?

grammar.title: 介绍自己
grammar.pattern: I'm + 名字 / I'm from + 地点
grammar.explanation: I'm 是 I am 的缩写。
grammar.example: I'm Lily. I'm from Shanghai.

grammar.title: 询问对方
grammar.explanation: 询问职业的常用说法，回答用 I'm a…
grammar.example: What do you do? I'm a teacher.
grammar.translation: 你是做什么的？我是老师。

grammar.title: 说喜好
grammar.explanation: like 后接动名词表示喜欢做某事。
grammar.example: I like reading.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.english: Hi, I'm Anna. I live next door.
dialogue.translation: 嗨，我是安娜，住在隔壁。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.english: Nice to meet you, Anna. I'm Ben.
dialogue.translation: 很高兴认识你，安娜。我是本。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.english: What do you like to do on the weekend?
dialogue.translation: 你周末喜欢做什么？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.english: I like cooking and playing tennis.
dialogue.translation: 我喜欢做饭和打网球。

words.example: What is the price of this bag?
These shoes are cheap.
The coat is too expensive.
Do you have this in a bigger size?
Can I try on this jacket?
Please pay at the cashier.
Everything is on sale today.
Do you need a bag?

grammar.title: 问价格
grammar.explanation: 单数用 is，复数用 are。
grammar.example: How much are these socks?

grammar.title: 表达想要
grammar.explanation: I'd like 比 I want 更礼貌。
grammar.example: I'd like a medium, please.

grammar.title: 比较
grammar.pattern: too + 形容词 / 形容词 + enough
grammar.explanation: too 表示“太……”，enough 放在形容词后。
grammar.example: It's too small. It isn't big enough.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Excuse me, how much is this jacket?
dialogue.translation: 打扰一下，这件夹克多少钱？

dialogue.speaker: Assistant
dialogue.english: It's 50 dollars. It's on sale today.
dialogue.translation: 50 美元，今天打折。

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Can I try on a bigger size?
dialogue.translation: 我能试一下大一号的吗？

dialogue.speaker: Assistant
dialogue.english: Sure. The fitting room is over there.
dialogue.translation: 当然，试衣间在那边。

words.example: Where is the train station?
I need a ticket to London.
words.translation: 我需要一张去伦敦的票。

words.example: Turn left at the bank.
Go straight for two blocks.
Can you show me on the map?
words.translation: 你能在地图上指给我看吗？

words.example: The bus stop is across the road.
The train leaves from platform 4.
words.translation: 火车从 4 号站台出发。

words.example: There is a lot of traffic today.

grammar.title: 礼貌问路
grammar.pattern: Could you tell me how to get to…?
grammar.explanation: 问路的礼貌说法，句末不用倒装。
grammar.example: Could you tell me how to get to the museum?
grammar.translation: 能告诉我怎么去博物馆吗？
options: Could you tell me where is the station?
Could you tell me where the station is?
Could you tell me the station where is?
grammar.answer: Could you tell me where the station is?

grammar.title: 方位介词
grammar.explanation: 用介词描述位置。
grammar.example: The bank is next to the café.
grammar.prompt: 补全：The bus stop is ___ the hotel.

grammar.title: 说明需要多久
grammar.explanation: 表示做某事需要多长时间。
grammar.example: It takes ten minutes to walk there.
options: It is taking 20 minutes by bus.

dialogue.speaker: Tourist
dialogue.english: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the station?
dialogue.translation: 打扰一下，能告诉我怎么去车站吗？

dialogue.speaker: Local
dialogue.english: Go straight and turn left at the bank.
dialogue.translation: 直走，在银行那里左转。

dialogue.speaker: Tourist
dialogue.english: Is it far?
dialogue.translation: 远吗？

dialogue.speaker: Local
dialogue.english: Not really. It takes about ten minutes to walk there.
dialogue.translation: 不远，走过去大概十分钟。

words.example: Can you call back later?
Can I leave a message?
Sorry, I'm busy right now.
I'd like to book a table for two.
I need to cancel my booking.
What is your phone number?
Can I speak to Mr. Lee, please?
Hold on, I'll get him.

grammar.title: 电话里找人
grammar.explanation: 打电话找人的标准说法。
grammar.example: Can I speak to the manager, please?
options: Can I speak to Mary, please?
Can I say to Mary, please?
grammar.answer: Can I speak to Mary, please?

grammar.title: 自报身份
grammar.explanation: 电话里用 This is 介绍自己，而不是 I am。
grammar.example: Hi, this is Tom from ABC.
grammar.translation: 你好，我是 ABC 公司的汤姆。

grammar.title: 将要做的事
grammar.explanation: 电话中临时答应做某事用 I'll。
grammar.example: I'll call you back in ten minutes.
grammar.translation: 我十分钟后给你回电话。

dialogue.speaker: Caller
dialogue.english: Hello, this is Mia. Can I speak to Dr. Brown, please?
dialogue.translation: 你好，我是米娅。请问布朗医生在吗？

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: I'm sorry, she's busy. Can I take a message?
dialogue.translation: 抱歉，她在忙。需要留言吗？

dialogue.speaker: Caller
dialogue.english: Yes. I need to cancel my appointment on Friday.
dialogue.translation: 好的，我需要取消周五的预约。

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: No problem. I'll tell her, and she'll call back later.
dialogue.translation: 没问题，我会转告她，她稍后回电。

words.example: The weather is nice today.
The forecast says it will rain.
Don't forget your umbrella.
It will be sunny tomorrow.
Do you have any plans for Sunday?
I want to invite you to dinner.
Are you free on Saturday?
Let's meet at the café at six.

grammar.title: 预测天气
grammar.pattern: It will + 动词原形 / It's going to…
grammar.explanation: 根据预报说将来的天气。
grammar.example: It's going to rain this afternoon.

grammar.title: 发出邀请
grammar.pattern: Would you like to + 动词原形?
grammar.explanation: 邀请别人一起做某事。
grammar.example: Would you like to see a movie?
grammar.prompt: 补全：Would you like ___ dinner with us?

grammar.title: 约定时间地点
grammar.pattern: at + 时刻 / on + 星期 / in + 月份
grammar.explanation: 时间介词：几点用 at，星期用 on，月份用 in。
grammar.example: See you on Friday at seven.
options: Let's meet in Sunday at noon.
Let's meet on Sunday at noon.
Let's meet at Sunday on noon.
grammar.answer: Let's meet on Sunday at noon.

dialogue.speaker: Kate
dialogue.english: Are you free on Saturday?
dialogue.translation: 你周六有空吗？

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.english: Yes. Do you have any plans?
dialogue.translation: 有空，你有什么安排吗？

dialogue.speaker: Kate
dialogue.english: Would you like to go hiking? The forecast says it will be sunny.
dialogue.translation: 想去徒步吗？天气预报说是晴天。

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.english: Sounds great. Let's meet at the station at nine.
dialogue.translation: 好主意，我们九点在车站见。
